summary: Iteration 6: tested the personalized painted tree (Gemini image edit) and the 12-month progression chart. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed, including 1 real generation on Léo followed by a reset. Frontend (admin/direction): generate/repaint/reset buttons, Maya's existing painting, a real Inès generation (busy label, then new painting; medallions still clickable), reset back to the base painting, the direction user being read-only, chart select and legend isolation, and level-inc updating both the legend and the current-month point all work. Mobile 390x844 has a HIGH layout bug: the overview grid rows collapse, so the detail column, the bottom charts and the future preview overlap.

minor.issue: Old generated tree images are never removed from db.avatars (kind='tree'), whether on reset or on repaint, so storage grows. There is also no rate limit or cooldown on this paid AI endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: The .overview-grid has height:100% and its children use min-h-0, so the auto rows shrink to their minimum content height: detail-column 27px, bottom-split 27px, future-preview 61px. The detail column, simulation zone and future preview are drawn on top of each other, and only the progression chart is readable. Fix verified via an injected style: add `@media (max-width:1023px){ .overview-grid { grid-auto-rows: max-content; } }` in enfance.css (or drop min-h-0 below lg). The panels then stack correctly: 608/675/612/214px.

issues: The X axis uses interval={1}, so only 6 of the 12 month labels show (nov, janv, mars, mai, juil, sept). The current month (the last point) has no label. Consider interval={0} with a smaller font, or label the last tick.
progression-domain-select is width:150px and clips its text to 'Tous les domaine' at 1920x1000.
The button reads "Peindre l'arbre de Inès"; it should be "d'Inès" for names starting with a vowel.

action_items: HIGH: fix the mobile overview grid row collapse (grid-auto-rows:max-content below 1024px, or remove min-h-0 from the grid children on mobile)
Show all 12 month labels on the progression X axis, or at least the current month
Widen progression-domain-select or shorten the label so 'Tous les domaines' is not clipped
Use "d'" before vowel-initial names in the tree-generate-button label
Optional: delete the old tree image docs on reset/repaint, and add a cooldown on tree generation
critical_code_review_comments: generate_tree and reset_tree leave orphaned base64 images in db.avatars, which can be large.
image_b64 downloads BASE_TREE (and external seed portraits) on every generation with no caching, which adds latency to each call.

monthlySeries: for a domain whose history starts later, earlier months use the first entry's 'from', which is correct. Domains with no history use the current level for every month (a flat line), which is expected.
seed_data_creation: A TEST_Arbre child was created and then deleted. Real generations used: 2 (Léo via API, Inès via UI), and both were reset to the base tree. Maya's scolaire level was raised from 2 to 3 and set back to 2, which added 2 current-month level_history entries. Maya's tree_image was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the login form fields auth-email-input, input[type=password] and auth-submit-button. Switch children with sidebar-child-switcher (select_option). The painted image is read from [data-testid=tree-painted-bg] image@href. Generation takes about 10-15s; wait for tree-reset-button. Click medallions at the centre of [data-domain-target=<id>] and wait 2.5s. Retest mobile 390x844 overview stacking.
